metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic modern gallery interior featuring a heavy bronze geometric sculpture suspended from a single thin steel cable. The cable extends upward to a reinforced concrete ceiling beam and appears taut with slight elastic stretch. The sculpture hangs motionless, centered directly below the anchor point. Natural daylight, high detail, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The cable aligns vertically with the sculpture's center of mass, showing appropriate tension and proper gravitational load distribution.
